headline: Where is my soulmate right now?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NO LOCATION, EVER — never place him, never name a setting, never 'someone you already know', never 'crossed paths before'. 🔴 NO PROXIMITY CLAIM: 'closer than you think' is the INCUMBENT cards-soulmate's answer, and if this family repeats it the two landers are the same lander while the dashboard still shows two rows. 🔴 NO STRATEGY — get out there, put yourself out there, stop looking, work on yourself first, 'it will happen when you…' are all directives. 🔴 Never her fault: no walls, no baggage, no standards, no 'too picky'.

Finding: the not-yet is not a DISTANCE. She turned an unanswerable ache into a geography question because geography felt answerable — so the read hands back the real shape of it without ever naming a place.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the blade on his table lies flat, pointing away from him.
You asked where your soulmate is right now. Your hand went to the man who makes rather than finds.
So this isn't a distance, dear. Nothing is keeping him miles from you.
And nothing on that table came from far away, dear.
But I won't give you an address, dear. There's none on this card.
That's why looking harder has never helped, dear. You were looking outward.
Let me look closer at what has been standing in that gap…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — his belt hangs down away from his waist.
You asked where your soulmate is right now. Your hand went to the card with no ground in it.
So there's no place on this card, dear. None at all.
And he hangs with no road and no map behind him, dear.
But you made it a somewhere else, dear. That felt easier to hold.
That's why you've thought about moving, dear. A new town, a fresh start.
Let me look closer at what's actually in your way…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his right foot is flat and his left one is lifting.
You asked where your soulmate is right now. Your hand went to the one with no fixed end.
So you're still moving, dear. You have not stopped at all.
And he's mid-step, dear, going somewhere he can't name yet.
But not knowing where isn't the same as stopping, dear.
That's why those years feel wasted to you, dear. The road was under you.
Let me look closer at what has been slowing your road…
